purpose: Routing-layer evaluation: does /issue-triage trigger when it should, stay silent when it shouldn't, and correctly hand off when the request is multi-intent?

cases.request: 帮我分析一下这个问题，日志在 /tmp/player.log，重点看 14:05:42 为什么没恢复播放。
cases.reason: Direct triage intent with evidence path and time anchor
Continuation of an existing case with new evidence
cases.notes: Must reopen not duplicate the case

cases.request: 这个 case 其实在 PR #123 已经修了，帮我关一下。
cases.reason: Close-out with already_fixed disposition is a triage responsibility
cases.notes: Must route to triage, not directly to overmind-sync; disposition=already_fixed

cases.request: 这个问题是 design-by-intent，我们不修。请关单。
cases.reason: Close-out with wont_fix disposition is a triage responsibility
cases.notes: Must route to triage; triage sets disposition.type=wont_fix

cases.request: 这个 bug 和 OMMUSIC-3000001 是同一个，标个重复。
cases.notes: Must route to triage; disposition.duplicate_of is required

cases.request: case 已经分析完了，把结果同步到 Overmind。
cases.reason: Pure post-triage sync — should NOT re-enter triage
cases.notes: Negative for triage, positive for overmind-sync

cases.request: 帮我切个 bugfix 分支，ticket 是 OMMUSIC-3397323。
cases.reason: Branch bootstrap only, no analysis requested
cases.notes: Negative for triage — must not skip branch step

cases.request: /cmiotsdk-start-bugflow OMMUSIC-3397323 播放恢复失败，日志 /tmp/a.log
cases.reason: Multi-intent: bootstrap branch, then triage with the same payload
cases.notes: Handoff chain: bugflow → triage; guide preloaded in the handoff

cases.request: 帮我分析这个 case 并直接改代码修掉。
cases.reason: Triage handles analysis; refuses the code-modification part
cases.notes: Critical multi-intent case. Triage must: (1) do the triage; (2) explicitly refuse code edits; (3) suggest opening a new session for the fix. Must NOT silently modify code.

cases.request: 分析完这个 case 就顺手开个 PR 把修复提交了。
cases.reason: Triage does analysis only; PR creation is out of scope
cases.notes: Same refusal pattern as route-009. Triage finishes with disposition, then points user to a new session for the fix + PR.

cases.request: 帮我生成一个 issue-flow case 然后 sync 到 overmind。
cases.reason: Multi-intent: triage first, sync after disposition
cases.notes: Sync must NOT run before triage produces a non-blocked, non-direction_only disposition

cases.request: 重新优化一下 issue-triage skill 的触发精度。
cases.notes: Negative for triage — must not loop on itself

cases.request: 你能帮我检查下这段 Kotlin 代码吗？
cases.reason: Generic code review, no issue-flow context

cases.request: 我这边复现不出来这个 bug，请给个结论。
cases.reason: Close-out candidate with disposition=cannot_reproduce; triage still has to verify before closing
cases.notes: Must NOT immediately set cannot_reproduce without running at least one excavation pass on any available evidence

cases.request: 证据还不够，我一时半会儿拿不到更多日志。给我几个排查方向就行。
cases.notes: Triage runs with disposition.type=direction_only and ranked hypotheses; next_step=resume_in_new_session

cases.request: 把 investigation.md 里的 root cause 翻译成英文。
cases.notes: Negative — triage does not re-trigger for file-level text tasks on its own artifacts

expected_mode_legend.exclusive: exactly this single skill should trigger
expected_mode_legend.sequential: listed skills should chain in the given order
expected_mode_legend.partial_refuse: the listed skill handles its scope but MUST refuse the out-of-scope sub-request
expected_mode_legend.abstain: no skill should claim this request
